description: Read bounded stored stock OHLCV history, ascending by trade date, as daily, weekly or monthly bars, with close-based price returns/drawdown and optional deterministic SMA, EMA, Wilder RSI and MACD. Useful for price trends, volatility context and technical analysis; use get_stock_metrics for a latest company snapshot. Up to 2600 recent daily source rows; dates filter that bounded window. Provider split/dividend adjustment is unknown: returns are not verified total returns. Missing OHLCV/indicator warm-up remains null; no synthetic sessions, intraday data or live quote claims. Read-only. Successful results include an optional platformLink for continuing this research or reviewing the exact saved draft in Bullrun. When useful, present its descriptive link and respect its description of any settings not carried over.

endDate.description: Inclusive last trade date; the API still loads the most recent source bars before this filter.

indicators.description: Optional indicators computed on the selected interval's closes after date filtering. Insufficient warm-up yields null, never a fabricated value.

interval.description: Aggregate stored daily bars. Weekly buckets start Monday; monthly buckets use the calendar month. No intraday or live quotes.

limit.description: Maximum most-recent DAILY source bars to load before date filtering and aggregation (hard cap 2600). Increase for indicator warm-up or longer history.

movingAveragePeriod.description: Observation count for SMA and EMA, in the selected interval.

rsiPeriod.description: Number of close-to-close changes for Wilder RSI. MACD uses fixed EMA periods 12/26 and signal 9.

startDate.description: Inclusive trade-date cutoff, applied after loading the latest source bars. Cannot page into history older than the source limit.

ticker.description: Exact native Bullrun stock ticker, e.g. AAPL, SAP or ABBN; find it with search_stocks. Do not append Yahoo exchange suffixes.

name: get_stock_price_history
title: Get stock price history and technical indicators
